facts.text: The hotel is in Viareggio's seaside Art Nouveau district.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the heart of Viareggio’s seaside Art Nouveau district

facts.text: The hotel is a 5-star design hotel affiliated with Relais & Chateaux.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Plaza e de Russie is a sophisticated 5-star design hotel affiliated with the Relais & Chateaux association

facts.text: The hotel was erected in 1871 along the route of the Grand Tour.
facts.excerpt: Erected in 1871 along the route of the Grand Tour

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as Viareggio's oldest hotel.
facts.excerpt: Nowhere is better than Hotel Plaza e de Russie, Viareggio’s oldest hotel

facts.text: Past guests included the poet Rainer Maria Rilke and Giacomo Puccini.
facts.excerpt: from the poet Rainer Maria Rilke, who gained inspiration on long walks through the woods, to Giacomo Puccini

facts.text: The 'de Russie' name comes from Russian expatriates and aristocrats who found shelter at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Events such as these gave the hotel not only a certain number of accounts that were to go forever unpaid, but also the “de Russie” name, which it maintains to this day.

facts.text: The hotel is the site of the Viareggio Prize, a literary award.
facts.excerpt: is also the site of the Viareggio Prize, one of Italy’s most prestigious literary awards

facts.text: The hotel is situated along a seaside promenade.
facts.excerpt: Situated along a seaside promenade, the hotel is in the heart of the Art Nouveau district that arose in the early 1900s

facts.text: Each room has its own character, with precious fabrics, warm understated tones and Italian design details.
facts.excerpt: each has its own personal character and features a sophisticated harmony of precious fabrics; warm, understated tones, and details that embody the essence of Italian design

facts.text: Each room has bathroom tiles with evocative geometries.
facts.excerpt: such as the evocative geometries of the bathroom tiles in each room

facts.text: The two penthouse suites have private terraces spanning the entire suite and full-length French doors.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s two penthouse suites are the epitome of luxury, privacy and comfort. Stunning private terraces span the entire suite, and full-length French doors let the Mediterranean sun illuminate the entire space.

facts.text: The Family Suite offers space and privacy a stone's throw from the beach.
facts.excerpt: Space and privacy at a stone’s throw from the beach

facts.text: The Junior Suite has a quiet internal outlook.
facts.excerpt: A pied-à-terre with a quiet internal outlook

facts.text: Lunasia Restaurant offers gourmet dining in a glamorous setting.
From the hotel, guests can visit Tuscan art cities, Elba Island and the Cinque Terre.
facts.excerpt: Tuscan cities of art famous around the world for their masterpieces of inestimable value, and natural environments with inimitable landscapes: from the crystalline waters of Elba Island to the Cinque Terre

facts.text: Nearby cultural events include the Puccini Festival of Torre del Lago and the Carnival of Viareggio.
facts.excerpt: Cultural events, such as the Palio of Siena or the Puccini Festival of Torre del Lago, or even the Carnivale of Viareggio itself
